title: Woman Holding Flowers, 1947 B&W Outdoor Portrait Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white photograph captured on May 30, 1947, depicting a young woman standing outdoors in a yard or orchard setting. She is holding a large, full bouquet of spring flowers, likely lilacs, and is dressed in mid-century attire including a plaid coat, a tied headscarf, and bobby socks. The background shows trees and an open field or orchard under leafy shade, reflecting post-WWII American suburban or rural life.
